proves.claim: Init in a copy of a scratch pytest project records pytest as the gate.

cli.journeys-languages-pytest.init-recor.why: Without it, a regression where init stops detecting a pytest project would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: A submitted commit with a failing pytest test is refused red and the refusal names the test.

cli.journeys-languages-pytest-red.a-fail.why: Without it, a regression where a red pytest gate is accepted or its refusal hides the failing test would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: The fixed pytest commit passes its gate, is accepted and lands on the scratch board main.

cli.journeys-languages-pytest-land.the-f.why: Without it, a regression where a green pytest item cannot land would pass unnoticed.
